updates.text: Mincey kept contain on every recorded rep, won the edge once against Johnson with the long arm and executed PEEL. He supplied the steadier lane evidence in the open Edge 1 comparison.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

short.text: Jeremy Mincey has been a regular in Jacksonville's edge rotation: he dressed for all {{2013.regular.games}} regular-season games in 2013 as the second edge in every recorded order and kept the first edge spot through the 2014 camp competition with Andre Branch. He is a sturdy edge defender whose strengths are power and setting the edge against the run, and in 2014 camp he kept contain on every recorded rep. His speed and bend around the corner are less of a threat than his physical play, and his get-off and pursuit are below a starter's standard.

transactions.text: Signed a four-year contract with Jacksonville
